S50U26.five_day_thesis: Over the last five scraped sessions the S50U26 future travelled 0.9 points net (1076.0 to 1076.9) inside a 6.2-point range, against an 8.85-point 1-sigma daily move - 5.6% realized against 13.05% implied. Max pain has sat at 1070 for five straight sessions after drifting up from 1060 on 5 August, while the 1080 call wall grew from 2,246 to 2,276 contracts and the 1050 put shelf added 27 to 1,304 - the cage is tightening in place rather than migrating. The gamma flip has held 1110 for four sessions (1120 on 5 August) with cumulative net GEX up 55% to +4,368, all of it stacked above 1100, which leaves spot 33.1 points deep inside the short-gamma corridor. Put OI added 1,234 against 582 on calls and the P/C OI ratio is flat at 1.74, so the book is accumulating insurance, not unwinding it. The result is a compressing coil whose amplification mechanism sits below the market: direction is undecided, but a break of 1050 is the side that gets hedged into rather than faded.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1060 / 1030
strategies.rationale: 48 DTE and put-rich Protection with dealers short gamma from 930 to 1110 means a loss of the 1,304-lot 1050 shelf gets hedged into, not faded - this is the cheap defined-risk downside insurance the zone calls for, and it buys the 13.22% 1060 put rather than the 23.32% tail.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = the 7.5-point net debit (1060 put 14.1 ask less 1030 put 6.6 bid); max value 30 points at 1030 or below; breakeven 1052.5.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above the 1080 call wall - the structure's ceiling and the only positive-GEX node below the flip.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1090 / 1110
strategies.rationale: A break above the 2,276-lot 1080 call wall runs through short-gamma territory where dealers must buy into strength, and the move mechanically stalls at 1110 where cumulative GEX flips positive - so the payoff is capped exactly where the amplification ends.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = the 7.1-point net debit (1090 call 14.8 ask less 1110 call 7.7 bid); max value 20 points at 1110 or above; breakeven 1097.1.
strategies.invalidation: A close back below 1070 max pain, which puts spot back under the 1080 cap with nothing above it bid.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1110 / 1130
strategies.rationale: This is the lowest-conviction leg and the only short-vol structure that is defensible here: it lives entirely above the 1110 flip, in the one region where cumulative GEX is positive and dealer hedging damps moves - with 13.05% implied sitting on top of 13.5% nine-session realized there is no volatility premium to harvest, so the edge is the long-gamma ceiling, not the vol level.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point wing width less the 3.5-point net credit = 16.5 points; a 1:4.7 payoff that demands the smallest size of the three - short vol is negative-skew, small frequent gains against rare large losses.
strategies.invalidation: A close above the 1110 gamma flip, which both breaches the short strike and voids the long-gamma premise the structure rests on.

S50U26.prediction: 1076.9 sits 6.9 points above the 1070 max pain that has anchored five sessions, and with 48 DTE and the 1050 / 1080 cage intact the base case is continued containment inside roughly 1050-1090, about 1-sigma wide either side. The asymmetry is downside: spot is 33.1 points below the 1110 flip, so a close under the 1050 shelf opens 1030 and 1020 on dealer selling into weakness, while a close above 1090 is the only path that reaches long-gamma air at 1110. A daily close outside 1050-1090 invalidates the coil read; inside it, 13.05% implied against 5.6% five-session realized keeps bleeding the long-vol structures.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position is being recommended. 12 August 2026 was a Thai market holiday, so this board is an unchanged carry of the 11 August close: all 1-day deltas are zero and the numbers describe a stale session, not live flow. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical share delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for stocks that settle in shares - treat the 1070 max pain and every wall as a tendency, not a guarantee. Defined risk is not risk-free: the capped max loss on each structure above is a real, full loss, and macro or news flow can override the entire option structure regardless of where the OI sits.
